job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. Listed below are a series of questions regarding your education and experience relating to the position. You must answer the following questionnaire as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to the supplemental questionnaire below will be used to determine your qualifications for this temporary recruitment. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification. It is important that your responses are true and accurate reflections of your background. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Options: I have read, understood, and agree to the above statements | I have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements. In selecting this, I voluntarily withdraw from the application process for this position

02. The temporary position requires certification as a Registered Dietitian with the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR). Do you possess the required certification? Please Note: Proof of certification will be required - you must attach a copy of your certification for review. ALL APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE REQUIRED CERTIFICATION WILL BE DISQUALIFIED. Options: Yes | No

03. The incumbent of this position is required to possess a valid driver's license or the ability to obtain transportation between job sites. Are you willing and able to comply with this requirement? Options: Yes | No

04. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required - you must attach a copy of your diploma or transcript for review. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No education | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree

05. How many years of experience do you have in implementing nutrition, health, or wellness strategies, intervention, and programs in a pre-k through 12th grade school setting? Options: No Experience | Less than one year of experience | At least one year, but less than two years | At least two years, but less than three years | At least three years, but less than four years | At least four years, but less than five years | Five years or more
